_schema: room.json IS the room. The page's engine (scene.js) draws only what is listed here, so a new object added to 'objects' is drawn, lit, casts and receives light, and can be tapped, with no code change.
Grid: 'grid' is [width, height] in art pixels. Every x and y below is in art pixels, (0,0) top left. Rows below 'floor.top' are floor.
OBJECT fields (only id, sprite, x, y are required):
id      a unique name.
sprite  a PNG in art/ (its unlit, flat colours: the albedo). 'sprites' (a list) instead gives poses the engine swaps between whole (the branch).
x, y    where the PNG's top-left pixel sits on the grid. Whole numbers only.
layer   'back' (drawn right after the wall, behind March), 'actor' (depth-sorted with March by 'base'), 'front' (over everything). Default 'actor'.
base    the floor row the object stands on, for depth sorting and floor shadows. Default: its bottom row.
lit     'pixel' (lit per pixel by the room's light; the default for still things), 'flat' (one light for the whole sprite, for things that move), 'emit' (shines by itself: the garden, the strip).
emit    for lit 'emit': a brightness, or {day, golden, night} each a number or [r,g,b]. Default: the hour's 'glow'.
cast    'floor' (a standing thing: its shadow falls on floor and wall), 'wall' (hung on the wall: a short shadow on the wall only), or leave it out (no shadow). 'castStrength' 0..1, default 0.85.

light   a light it gives off, or a list of them: {x, y, radius, color:[r,g,b] linear 0..1, strength: number or {day, golden, night}, pulse: [amount, seconds] slow breathing, line: length (a light along a row from x to x+line), shadow: true if things cast shadows from it}.

tap     what a tap on it does: 'flare' (its lights flare, a ring of light ripples out, petals burst), 'nudge' (it jiggles one pixel and puffs dust), 'gust' (a gust of wind through the leaves), 'visit' (March walks over to its spot).

spot    where March stands to visit it: {x, y (her feet), face: 'L' or 'R', hold: [min, max] seconds, weight: {day, golden, night} how often she chooses to go there on her own}. 'use': 'desk' makes her sit and work there.
block   [x0, y0, x1, y1]: a box of floor her FEET may not cross.
sheds   {rate: petals a second, color:[r,g,b] 0..255}: little petals fall from it now and then.

card    which of the page's cards a tap on it opens (room.js CARD: march, bench, desk, season, wall, shelf, board, cloud, quill, clock). A thing with a card is tappable even with no 'tap'; a thing with both does both (the door flares AND opens the season). 'name' is what the hover label says.
kind    'panel' is drawn by code (the floating glass panel, its text, the live title); give it 'box': [x0, y0, x1, y1] instead of a sprite.

HOURS: day, golden and night each set the light; the page blends them by the real Chiang Mai clock (UTC+7) through 'clock.keys' [hour, name]. ?t=day|golden|night forces one; ?time=17.4 forces a clock time.

ambient [r,g,b] light everywhere; sun {x, y, rx, ry, color, cast:[ox, oy, kx, ky], leaf:[dx, dy, shear]} the main light from outside (its pool is an ellipse; cast projects shadows: a pixel h rows above its base lands at x+ox+kx*h, y+oy+ky*h; leaf moves and shears the leaf shadows); vignette [cx, cy, how much the far corners lose]; floor (the floor's light, times); glow [r,g,b] emitters' brightness; sprite {tint, mix}: moving sprites get mix of the room's light and (1-mix) of tint.

LEAVES: sprays of leaves on twigs hanging in from a tree out of frame; each {seed, x, y (its root), angle, length, curl, strength: {day, golden, night} how dark its shadow is}. They are rebuilt from shapes every frame, swaying on springs in the wind.
MARCH: her frames (assets/march.json), her foot point in a 48-px frame, the desk's sit place, where she may walk (floor.walk: [x0, y0, x1, y1] for her feet), and her behaviour weights by hour.
